name: org.machanism.machai:project-layout
description: Project Layout is a Java utility library for detecting, describing, and working with conventional project directory layouts. It provides a common ProjectLayout abstraction and implementations for Maven, Gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript package.json workspaces, Python project indicators, and default fallback directory scanning. The library helps build tooling, repository scanners, documentation generators, validation tools, indexing tools, and plugins locate production source roots, resource roots, test roots, documentation roots, modules, and project metadata without hard-coding ecosystem-specific conventions. It includes Maven metadata support through PomReader, project layout detection through ProjectLayoutManager, and recursive project or module traversal through ProjectProcessor. Typical use cases include resolving Maven src/main/java and src/main/resources, Maven test and documentation paths, Gradle conventional src/main and src/test paths, JavaScript workspace modules, Python project detection, and default immediate-subdirectory module discovery.

usageContext: Python projects using pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, requirements.txt, Pipfile, or virtual environment indicators

constructors.description: Creates a Maven layout resolver that reads Maven build metadata from pom.xml and exposes modules, source/resource directories, test directories, and documentation directories. Configure it with projectDir(java.io.File) before reading layout information.

examples.description: Creates and configures a MavenProjectLayout for a real Maven project. Use the returned root-relative paths to drive a scanner, generator, validator, or documentation tool. Add the dependency with Maven coordinates org.machanism.machai:project-layout:1.3.2 before compiling this code.

constructors.description: Creates a Gradle layout resolver that uses Gradle project conventions and the Gradle Tooling API to expose child modules, src/main, src/test, and src/site paths.

examples.description: Installs the component as a Maven dependency, then creates a GradleProjectLayout for a Gradle build directory. The layout returns conventional source roots and child module names for tool automation.

constructors.description: Creates a fallback layout resolver for projects that do not match Maven, Gradle, JavaScript, or Python detection rules. It treats immediate subdirectories of the configured root as potential modules while excluding known build and tooling directories.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.DefaultProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.DefaultProjectLayout();
java.util.List<java.lang.String> modules = layout.projectDir(new java.io.File("C:\\repo")).getModules();
examples.description: Uses the fallback resolver when no specialized build metadata is present. This is practical for generic repositories where immediate child folders should be treated as modules.

constructors.description: Creates a JavaScript or TypeScript layout resolver that inspects package.json and package.json workspaces to identify project identity and workspace module paths.

examples.description: Configures the library for a package.json based repository and reads workspace module paths for monorepo scanning.

constructors.description: Creates a Python project layout resolver. The implementation detects Python project indicators such as pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, requirements.txt, Pipfile, virtual environment directories, and Python file structures, while returning safe empty defaults for source, document, and test roots until deeper discovery is implemented.

examples.description: Checks whether a folder looks like a Python project and prepares a PythonProjectLayout instance for consistent processing in mixed-language repository tools.

features.name: detectProjectLayout
features.signature: public static org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout detectProjectLayout(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.FileNotFoundException
features.description: Detects the appropriate ProjectLayout implementation for a project directory. It supports Maven projects, Node.js or JavaScript package.json projects, Python projects, and default fallback layouts. It returns a configured layout abstraction for subsequent source, test, document, and module discovery.

examples.description: Practical scenario: install org.machanism.machai:project-layout:1.3.2 in a build tool, pass a repository root, and let the library choose MavenProjectLayout, JScriptProjectLayout, PythonProjectLayout, or DefaultProjectLayout automatically.

features.name: getSources
features.description: Returns root-relative production source and resource directories for the selected layout. MavenProjectLayout reads build metadata and defaults to Maven conventions when necessary; GradleProjectLayout returns conventional src/main; default, JavaScript, and Python layouts return safe empty defaults where source discovery is not implemented.

examples.description: Runs source-root discovery for a Maven project and resolves every root-relative path against the configured project directory before using it in analysis or generation.

features.name: getTests
features.description: Returns root-relative test source and test resource directories. MavenProjectLayout inspects Maven build metadata and applies Maven defaults, while GradleProjectLayout returns src/test by convention.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("C:\\work\\library"));
java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> testRoots = layout.getTests();
examples.description: Retrieves test roots for a Maven library so a validation tool can include test fixtures or exclude tests from production indexing.

features.name: getDocuments
features.description: Returns root-relative documentation directories. MavenProjectLayout and GradleProjectLayout use src/site as the conventional documentation input location.

examples.description: Discovers documentation roots for a project so site generators, Bindex metadata generators, or documentation validators can locate markdown, PlantUML, and site resources.

features.name: getModules
features.description: Returns module directories or names for multi-module repositories. MavenProjectLayout returns modules declared in pom.xml for packaging pom projects, GradleProjectLayout returns child Gradle project names, JScriptProjectLayout returns matching package.json workspace module paths, and DefaultProjectLayout treats immediate subdirectories as potential modules.

examples.description: Scans a monorepo for modules using the detected build-system-specific strategy and prints each module identifier.

features.name: scanFolder
features.signature: public void scanFolder(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Scans a project root, detects the project layout, recursively processes modules when present, and delegates concrete handling to a subclass implementation of processFolder(ProjectLayout).

examples.description: Implements a minimal processor, runs it against a repository root, and lets ProjectProcessor delegate each detected module or folder to processFolder.

features.name: getProjectModel
features.description: Loads and returns a Maven Model from a pom.xml file after property substitution. PomReader also exposes parsed POM properties and can serialize Maven Model objects back to XML.

examples.description: Reads Maven metadata for a project and serializes it for diagnostics, documentation, or indexing workflows.

customizations.name: ProjectProcessor.processFolder
customizations.description: Subclass ProjectProcessor and implement processFolder(ProjectLayout) to define custom behavior for each detected project folder or module, such as indexing files, generating documentation, validating layout conventions, or collecting metrics.

examples.description: Creates a custom processor that prints project identity and source roots for every scanned folder or module.

customizations.name: ProjectLayout
customizations.description: Extend ProjectLayout to add support for another ecosystem or repository convention. Implement getSources(), getDocuments(), and getTests(), and optionally override getModules(), getProjectId(), getProjectName(), and getParentId().

examples.description: Shows the minimum implementation needed to introduce a custom layout strategy for a non-standard repository structure.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout
studs.description: Gateway abstraction for all project layout implementations. It defines the contract for configuring a project root and returning root-relative source, document, test, and optional module paths.

examples.description: Uses the abstract ProjectLayout contract without coupling calling code to Maven, Gradle, JavaScript, Python, or default layout implementations.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectProcessor
studs.description: Gateway processor for traversing project roots and modules. Subclasses implement processFolder(ProjectLayout) to provide concrete folder processing behavior.

examples.description: Creates an inline processor implementation for layout-aware folder processing.

examples.title: Install and use Project Layout in a Maven-based scanner
examples.description: Add Project Layout as a dependency, configure a target folder, detect the layout, and use root-relative source, test, and documentation paths in a scanner or generator.
steps: Add the Maven dependency org.machanism.machai:project-layout:1.3.2 to the application that performs scanning or generation.
Create a java.io.File pointing to the project root that must be analyzed.
Call org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectLayoutManager.detectProjectLayout(java.io.File) to select the correct layout implementation.
Read getSources(), getTests(), getDocuments(), and getModules() and resolve each returned path against layout.getProjectDir().

examples.title: Process every module in a mixed repository
examples.description: Use ProjectProcessor when the tool needs to recurse through modules and apply custom processing to each detected project layout.
steps: Install org.machanism.machai:project-layout:1.3.2 in the processing application.
Create a subclass or anonymous implementation of org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectProcessor.
Implement processFolder(org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout) with the real indexing, validation, or generation logic.
Invoke scanFolder(java.io.File) with the repository root.

examples.title: Run a Maven build after adding the dependency
examples.description: Project Layout is consumed as a normal Java library from Maven Central. After adding the dependency, compile or verify the application with Maven.
steps: Ensure Java 8 or later and Maven 3.x or later are installed.
Add the dependency block to pom.xml.
Run mvn clean verify from the application root.
Execute the application code that uses ProjectLayoutManager, ProjectLayout, or ProjectProcessor.
